visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The man slices into a golden-brown roasted chicken inside a silver tray. He wears a dark olive shirt, a black tactical vest, and a headlamp. The outdoor setting at night is dimly lit, with the chicken glistening under the headlamp's focused beam. (2) In a sequence showing preparation, the man pours chopped bell peppers and onions into the tray, then places a whole raw chicken on top. He covers it with a flat lid and attaches the tray to a metal tripod structure positioned directly over a brightly burning wood fire. (3) He uses tongs to place glowing coals onto the flat lid to provide top heat. Sparks from the campfire dance in the air around the suspended cooking setup. The background shows camping gear and the dark silhouette of a vehicle parked nearby in the forest. (4) The man opens the lid to reveal the cooked chicken, which emits a cloud of steam. He carves a piece and eats it with visible enjoyment, giving a thumbs-up gesture to the camera. Large yellow-and-white text overlays appear at the bottom, promoting the camping pot set.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 套鍋烤全雞超好吃. (2) [Subtitle]: 切一片. (3) [Subtitle]: 你看都白色熟透了. (4) [Subtitle]: 喲，超香啊. (5) [Subtitle]: 下方放入蔬菜, 瓜類, 搭配辛香料. (6) [Subtitle]: 放入全雞. 買小隻, 壓扁, 肚子塞洋蔥, 大蒜, 香料. (7) [Subtitle]: 高度剛剛好. (8) [Subtitle]: 我們等下把火調一下. (9) [Subtitle]: 把這放在上面當上火. (10) [Subtitle]: 但是這樣當烤箱用的話呢. 上蓋是有可能會變形的. 所以大家能夠接受. 因為我都無所謂啦. 我都隨便用. 反正這是盤子而已. (11) [Subtitle]: 我們先計時20分鐘. 然後再掀開看一下. 看到調整火力大小或者是位置. (12) [Subtitle]: 等下等下. 看看烤雞喲. 來, 開鍋哦. 哦, 對焦冒煙誒. (13) [Subtitle]: 我們這樣大概, 總共大概烤了差不多一個小時. 但其中大概10分鐘的悶烤. 烤雞怎麼看有沒有熟呢? 看這個大腿這邊最裡面, 這邊, 最裡面這的肉. (14) [Slogan]: 野岩露營套鍋 預購優惠中.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a male voice speaking enthusiastically in Mandarin, punctuated by the sharp, rhythmic metallic sounds of a knife and fork scraping against a stainless steel tray. A faint, uplifting acoustic guitar melody provides a soft background bed under his narrative about the chicken. (2) A distinct metallic clang occurs as the man places the heavy lid onto the cooking tray. This is followed immediately by the organic, mid-frequency crackling and popping of wood burning in a campfire, creating a dense atmospheric texture of an outdoor camping environment. (3) As the speaker continues his instructional commentary, several high-pitched metallic clicks from tongs are heard as he manipulates burning coals. The fire noise remains consistent, with occasional gusts of wind noise being picked up by the microphone, adding to the field recording feel. (4) A new phase is marked by a burst of cheerful laughter from an off-screen individual, coinciding with the subtle sound of steam escaping as the pot is opened. The speaker's voice rises in pitch and arousal, expressing excitement at the visual result of the roast. (5) The sound of the man chewing and swallowing is audibly emphasized, followed by a satisfied vocal exclamation. The background music swells slightly in volume, concluding the segment with a blend of natural fire crackling and a final promotional statement delivered with high vocal confidence.
